# Sushant Tare

> Portfolio site for Sushant Tare, a Mobile Application Developer specializing in Flutter and Dart. Builds production Play Store apps with real-time data integration, modular architecture, and offline-first design.

## Profile

- [About](https://sushanttare.netlify.app/#about): Mobile Application Developer summary, core skills (Flutter, Dart, GetX, Firebase, REST/WebSockets), certifications (AWS CLF-C02, Azure DP-203), and job simulations.
- [Work Experience](https://sushanttare.netlify.app/#experience): Mobile Application Developer at TrustLink Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Sep 2024–Present), sole mobile developer on the OctaNet broadband network management platform.
- [Education](https://sushanttare.netlify.app/#education): MSc IT and BSc IT, Sonopant Dandekar College, Palghar.
- [Published Papers](https://sushanttare.netlify.app/#papers): Research papers including Cravecoin, Fiberflow (IJIRT), Towzer, Quantaview, and Fit&Fuel.
- [Projects](https://sushanttare.netlify.app/#projects): OctaNet (production Flutter app), Cravecoin, Fit&Fuel, Power Gauge, Quantaview, Stoxium.
- [Contact](https://sushanttare.netlify.app/#contact): Email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram, and resume download.
